title: Generic measured clause partition and product-budget Horn SAT
claims: ExactHornProductSAT checks exact P membership for canonical SAT with a polynomially bounded product of widths of non-Horn clauses.
ExactClausePartitionProductSAT checks the generic measured exact-language construction with a base solver and a measured clause predicate that accepts units and empty clauses.
MeasuredCNFPartition checks the exact raw partition and measured machine construction.
ExactHornSAT checks P membership for the exact canonical Horn restriction.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
